criteria.description: src/data/products.ts must set featured: true on exactly the products with ids 1 (Laptop), 8 (Ergonomic Chair), 11 (Yoga Mat), and 14 (Clean Code). All other product entries must not have featured: true.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/data/products.ts: id 1 line 14 'featured: true', id 8 line 92 'featured: true', id 11 line 126 'featured: true', id 14 line 163 'featured: true'. All other 11 products (ids 2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10,12,13,15) have no 'featured' field. Test 'Featured filter > returns only featured products when featured=true' PASSED (vitest run, 23/23 tests passed).

criteria.description: src/utils/queryParser.ts must parse the featured query param: 'true' -> query.featured = true, 'false' -> query.featured = false, any other value (including absence) leaves query.featured undefined.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/utils/queryParser.ts lines 22-26: 'if (raw.featured === "true") { query.featured = true; } else if (raw.featured === "false") { query.featured = false; }' — no else branch, so other values leave query.featured undefined. Tests 'Featured filter > returns only non-featured products when featured=false' and 'GET /products > returns all products with pagination envelope' both PASSED (vitest run, 23/23 tests passed).

criteria.description: src/utils/queryParser.ts must include 'rating_desc' in its VALID_SORT_OPTIONS array so that sort=rating_desc is accepted and forwarded to the service rather than silently dropped.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/utils/queryParser.ts line 3: 'const VALID_SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = ["price_asc", "price_desc", "name_asc", "name_desc", "rating_desc"];' — 'rating_desc' is present. Test 'Rating sort > sorts by rating descending when sort=rating_desc' PASSED (vitest run, 23/23 tests passed).

criteria.description: src/services/productService.ts must apply a featured filter when query.featured !== undefined: keep only products where (p.featured ?? false) === query.featured. The filter must compose with existing filters (search, category, inStock).
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/services/productService.ts lines 23-25: 'if (query.featured !== undefined) { result = result.filter((p) => (p.featured ?? false) === query.featured); }' — applied after search/category/inStock filters, confirming composition. Tests: 'Featured filter > returns only featured products when featured=true' (4 products) PASSED, 'Featured filter > returns only non-featured products when featured=false' (11 products) PASSED, 'Featured filter > featured=true combined with category filter returns intersection' (1 product, id=1) PASSED (vitest run, 23/23 tests passed).

criteria.description: src/services/productService.ts must sort by rating descending (highest first) when query.sort === 'rating_desc', without mutating the source array.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/services/productService.ts lines 35-36: 'else if (query.sort === "rating_desc") { result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating); }' — spread operator used, no mutation. Test 'Rating sort > sorts by rating descending when sort=rating_desc' PASSED (vitest run, 23/23 tests passed).
